# Notched bar ssna303 in 3D (example ex4 of mfem-mgis-examples, variant
# solved by hypre): finite strain plasticity (logarithmic strain of Hencky,
# linear isotropic hardening), with its behaviour generated by the
# generic-parallel interface, for the measurements of the integration by
# batches. The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its build
# directory; the mode of integration is given by the environment variables
# of mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_BINARY_DIR}/ex4"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex4 of mfem-mgis-examples")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ssna303-behaviours CUDA
  "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex4/IsotropicLinearHardeningPlasticity.mfront")

# short tests: the first time step of the loading on two processes, the
# resultant force on the upper boundary being compared to the reference
# values of the example, point by point (generic library of the example), by
# batches with each backend, all the computations by kernels
proto_check_executable(_usable "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}/ssna303_3d_hypre")
if(_usable)
  set(_run mpirun -n 2 ./ssna303_3d_hypre --no-paraview --nbsteps 1
           --end-time 0.1 --reference-file ssna303_3d-force-10steps.ref)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  add_test(NAME ssna303-point-by-point COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ssna303-kernels COMMAND ${_run}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ssna303-kernels PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
  # FBar formulation: point by point, and by kernels on the host and on the
  # GPU, compared to the reference values of the example with FBar
  set(_run_fbar mpirun -n 2 ./ssna303_3d_hypre --no-paraview --nbsteps 1
                --end-time 0.1 --use-fbar
                --reference-file ssna303_3d-force-10steps-fbar.ref)
  add_test(NAME ssna303-fbar-point-by-point COMMAND ${_run_fbar}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
  add_test(NAME ssna303-fbar-kernels COMMAND ${_run_fbar}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
  set_tests_properties(ssna303-fbar-kernels PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
  foreach(_backend ${ssna303-behaviours_BACKENDS})
    set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
    if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
      add_test(NAME ssna303-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} --device cuda -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
      add_test(NAME ssna303-fbar-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run_fbar} --device cuda -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ssna303-batch-${_backend}
        ssna303-fbar-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}"
        RESOURCE_LOCK gpu)
    else()
      add_test(NAME ssna303-batch-${_backend}
        COMMAND ${_run} -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX4_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(ssna303-batch-${_backend} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;OMP_NUM_THREADS=2")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
